cohort: 544 low-risk singleton pregnancies with breech presentation in labor
finding: Booked patients with breech presentation had a higher rate of cesarean section, increased maternal morbidity, longer hospital stays, and higher costs compared to non-booked patients.
mod_finding: 80% of booked cases had cesarean sections compared to 10% of non-booked cases.
birth_weight: In booked cesarean section, 28% of babies weighed >3.5 kg vs. 6% in unbooked; vaginally delivered breech babies weighed <3kg
